description: This file defines the WizardInterface interface for conditional formatting in PhpSpreadsheet, specifying method signatures for managing cell range, style, condition, and creation from a Conditional object.

classes.name: WizardInterface
classes.description: Interface specifying methods for conditional formatting wizard operations, including range, style, stop condition, and conditional object handling.

methods.name: getCellRange
methods.description: Returns the cell range to which the conditional formatting applies.

methods.name: setCellRange
methods.description: Sets the cell range for the conditional formatting.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style applied for conditional formatting.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets the style to be applied for conditional formatting.

methods.name: getStopIfTrue
methods.description: Indicates whether to stop evaluating further rules if this condition is true.

methods.name: setStopIfTrue
methods.description: Sets the stop-if-true flag for the conditional rule.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Retrieves the Conditional object associated with this wizard.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates an instance of the wizard from a Conditional object and a cell range.
